The AI Factory, Cut Open

One building, nine floors: from the power lines at the bottom to the agents answering questions at the top. Tap a floor to see what it does, where it gets stuck, who runs it and every article on the site that covers it, or switch to the flow view to follow electricity, capital, chips, data and talent as they turn into trained models and answers.

⚠️ About this map. Floor details come from the site's series hubs and articles (as of 27 October 2026). Bottleneck, openness and concentration ratings and the flow-view cost shares are our own editorial model, not measurements; real shares vary widely by site and year.
